name: Painting the Desert

start.dialog: The Dustbelt needs ART! I'm painting a mural - the biggest sign EVER! But I need pigments! Red desert clay, yellow sand-flower pollen, and cactus juice for green! Bring 'em and I'll paint YOU into it!
start.objective: Collect red desert clay, yellow sand-flower pollen, and cactus juice

progress.dialog: Got any of those pigments? The wall is PREPPED! Just waiting on COLORS!

complete.dialog: PERFECT colors! Look at this RED! This YELLOW! This... slightly stinging GREEN! The mural will be LEGENDARY! Here's your portrait sketch - come back when it's done!

party_comments.kade: Art... not my strong suit, but I respect the work.
party_comments.ashka: Desert colors have their own beauty. He's capturing that.
party_comments.twist: I want to be painted as a HERO! With a cape!

hidden_outcome: If you bring rare blue cactus juice, Sam paints you with a 'mysterious aura' that grants +1 Charisma when standing near the completed mural
